title: Nutritious Bitter Argentinian Rice Stew
description: A frothy, slightly bitter Argentinian rice stew enriched with apple juice, lentils, and aromatic vegetables, perfect for a post-workout recovery meal.
instructions: Rinse 150 g of white rice under cold running water until the water runs clear.
Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté 1 medium diced onion and 2 minced garlic cloves until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Add 1 cup diced carrots, 30 g dried lentils, 500 ml vegetable broth, 200 ml apple juice, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, reduce to low heat, add the rinsed rice, cover, and simmer for 35 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with 1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp black pepper, stirring again.
Remove the pot from heat, fluff the stew with a fork, and let it rest covered for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle chopped fresh parsley on top before serving.
Serve hot as a satisfying post-workout Argentinian rice stew.
